generates_full_input_for.definition: The source provides all non-user-supplied required data inputs needed for direct execution of the target.

generates_partial_input_for.definition: The source provides at least one meaningful required target input while other required inputs remain unsatisfied.

preprocesses_for.definition: The source prepares or repairs scientific data specifically for direct use by the target.

converts_format_for.definition: The source converts an artifact into a format directly consumed by the target.

parameterizes_for.definition: The source produces parameters or configuration data directly consumed by the target.

filters_candidates_for.definition: The source filters a candidate collection that is subsequently consumed by the target.

ranks_or_scores_for.definition: The source ranks or scores candidates for subsequent target processing.

validates_output_of.definition: The target validates a scientific output produced by the source.

refines_output_of.definition: The target refines or improves a scientific output produced by the source.

reports_or_summarizes.definition: The target reports, visualizes, or summarizes a scientific output produced by the source.

alternative_to.definition: The tools provide substitutable capabilities for the same scientific role under comparable inputs and outputs.
